headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs. The Washington Nationals took down the Arizona Diamondbacks in a doubleheader, winning 5-3 and 10-7. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels 9-2, while the Toronto Blue Jays shut out the Boston Red Sox 6-0.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Cody Bellinger (New York Yankees) who was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. Other injured players include Shea Langeliers (Athletics), Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins), Josh Jung (Texas Rangers), Spencer Arrighetti (Houston Astros), Juan Soto (New York Mets), Shawn Armstrong (Cleveland Guardians), and Tanner Banks (Philadelphia Phillies).

The Washington Nationals made a trade with the Boston Red Sox, acquiring Connelly Early in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead. The Philadelphia Phillies traded for CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals, while the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 3-2. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Giants Dominate Angels in 9-2 Rout**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 9-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, with Robbie Ray earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease. Cease pitched 9.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Close Match**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 1-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians in a tightly contested game. Impact performances came from Parker Messick and Drew Rasmussen on the mound, while Chandler Simpson stood out at the plate.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with several players making an impact on the game. Geraldo Perdomo, Gabriel Moreno, Ketel Marte, and Ryan Waldschmidt led the Diamondbacks' offense, while James Wood, Dylan Crews, CJ Abrams, Brady House, Jacob Young, and Luis García Jr. contributed to the Nationals' win.

top_news.title: **Bellinger Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Yankees left fielder Cody Bellinger has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The injury occurred on July 26, 2026.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Curtis Mead in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox made a move on July 26, 2026, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead.
